scope.zh: 本站原创教学推导；定义与建模规则明确标注，近似说明条件。进阶推导会列出所用的先修定理。
scope.en: Original teaching derivations. Definitions and modeling rules are labeled; approximations state their conditions. Advanced derivations identify prerequisite theorems.

references.title: NIST · Confidence limits for the mean
Rutgers / NYU · Probability: Limit Theorems I

kind.zh: 定义与等值变形
kind.en: Definitions and equivalent forms

derivation.zh: 百分比的定义是“每100份中的份数”。所以20%=20/100；分子分母同除以100，得到0.20。一般地，r%=r/100。
derivation.en: Percent means parts per hundred. Thus 20%=20/100=0.20. In general, r%=r/100.

derivation.zh: 把总量记为T，部分记为A。比例r=A/T（T>0），故A=rT；这里r必须用小数形式。
derivation.en: Write total T and part A. The proportion is r=A/T for T>0, so A=rT, with r in decimal form.

derivation.zh: 若先保留原量的20%，再保留这部分的50%，最终保留量=(T×0.20)×0.50=0.10T。第二次的分母已变成第一次后的数量。
derivation.en: Keeping 20% and then 50% of that leaves (T×0.20)×0.50=0.10T. The second percentage applies to the intermediate amount.
The fraction not retained is (T−0.10T)/T=1−0.20×0.50=0.90. Do not add the two percentages.

scenario.zh: 仓库有200件商品。先选出20%，再从选出的商品中取50%。最终取多少件？原批次还剩多少比例？
scenario.en: A warehouse has 200 items. Select 20%, then take 50% of those selected. How many are taken, and what fraction of the original remains?

steps.en: Take 40×0.50=20 items, or 20/200=0.10 of the original.

kind.zh: 代数等价变形与运算顺序
kind.en: Equivalent algebra and order of operations

derivation.zh: 等式两边做同一种可逆运算，解保持不变。2x+4=10两边减4，得到2x=6。
derivation.en: Applying the same reversible operation to both sides preserves solutions. Subtract 4 from 2x+4=10 to get 2x=6.
Divide both sides by nonzero 2: x=6/2=(10−4)/2=3. Substitution gives 2×3+4=10.

derivation.zh: 平方是数乘自己：a²=a×a。主平方根√b定义为平方等于b的非负数（b≥0）；因此√25=5，而方程x²=25有±5两根。
derivation.en: A square is a²=a×a. The principal root √b is the nonnegative number whose square is b, for b≥0. Thus √25=5, while x²=25 has roots ±5.
Evaluate parentheses first: (2+3)²=25. Expansion gives 2²+2×2×3+3²=4+12+9, not 2²+3².

scenario.zh: SE=20/√n，要使SE=2，n应为多少？同时求2x+4=10的解。
scenario.en: For SE=20/√n, find n giving SE=2. Also solve 2x+4=10.

steps.en: Sample size n is positive. Write 2=20/√n.
Multiply both sides by √n: 2√n=20. Divide by 2: √n=20/2=10.

steps.zh: 另一方程先减4再除2，x=3；检验2×3+4=10。
steps.en: For the other equation, subtract 4 then divide by 2 to obtain x=3. Check: 2×3+4=10.
Also √25=5 because 5 is nonnegative and 5²=25. (2+3)²=25, checked by expanding to 4+12+9=25.

kind.zh: 均值的定义与求和记号
kind.en: Definition of the mean and summation notation

derivation.zh: n个观测值记作x₁,…,xₙ，下标只标识第几个观测。总量S=x₁+x₂+…+xₙ。
derivation.en: Label n observations x₁,…,xₙ. The subscript identifies the observation. Their total is S=x₁+…+xₙ.

derivation.zh: 算术平均数是把总量均分成n份后每份的量，故n×x̄=S。
derivation.en: The arithmetic mean is the equal share when the total is split into n parts, so n×x̄=S.

derivation.zh: n>0时，两边除以n：x̄=(x₁+…+xₙ)/n。Σᵢ₌₁ⁿxᵢ是这n项相加的简写，因而x̄=Σxᵢ/n。
derivation.en: For n>0, divide by n: x̄=(x₁+…+xₙ)/n. The notation Σᵢ₌₁ⁿxᵢ abbreviates the sum, giving x̄=Σxᵢ/n.

derivation.zh: 检查偏差和：Σ(xᵢ−x̄)=Σxᵢ−nx̄=S−S=0。这是均值的代数性质，不是每个观测都等于均值。
derivation.en: The deviations sum to zero: Σ(xᵢ−x̄)=Σxᵢ−nx̄=0. This does not mean each observation equals the mean.

scenario.zh: 三天订单量为2、4、6，求均值与偏差和。
scenario.en: Daily order counts are 2, 4 and 6. Find their mean and the sum of deviations.

steps.en: Their sum is zero. The mean also recovers the total: 3×4=12.

kind.zh: 定义与样本方差修正的推导
kind.en: Definitions and derivation of the sample variance correction

derivation.zh: 完整等权总体有N个值，μ=Σxᵢ/N。用平方避免正负偏差抵消，定义σ²=Σ(xᵢ−μ)²/N；σ=√σ²恢复原单位。
derivation.en: For an equally weighted population, μ=Σxᵢ/N. Define σ²=Σ(xᵢ−μ)²/N to avoid cancellation of signed deviations. Its square root restores the original units.

derivation.zh: 现在改为从总体独立同分布抽样X₁,…,Xₙ，E(Xᵢ)=μ、Var(Xᵢ)=σ²<∞，n≥2。写Xᵢ−X̄=(Xᵢ−μ)−(X̄−μ)。
derivation.en: Now take iid observations with mean μ and finite variance σ², n≥2. Write Xᵢ−X̄=(Xᵢ−μ)−(X̄−μ).

derivation.zh: 逐项平方后求和：Σ(Xᵢ−X̄)²=Σ(Xᵢ−μ)²−2(X̄−μ)Σ(Xᵢ−μ)+n(X̄−μ)²。
derivation.en: Squaring and summing gives Σ(Xᵢ−X̄)²=Σ(Xᵢ−μ)²−2(X̄−μ)Σ(Xᵢ−μ)+n(X̄−μ)².

derivation.zh: 因为Σ(Xᵢ−μ)=n(X̄−μ)，上式简化为Σ(Xᵢ−μ)²−n(X̄−μ)²。
derivation.en: Since Σ(Xᵢ−μ)=n(X̄−μ), this simplifies to Σ(Xᵢ−μ)²−n(X̄−μ)².

derivation.zh: 独立性给Var(X̄)=ΣVar(Xᵢ)/n²=σ²/n，且E(X̄)=μ。取期望得E[Σ(Xᵢ−X̄)²]=nσ²−n×σ²/n=(n−1)σ²。
derivation.en: Independence gives Var(X̄)=σ²/n and E(X̄)=μ. Therefore E[Σ(Xᵢ−X̄)²]=nσ²−σ²=(n−1)σ².

derivation.zh: 所以S²=Σ(Xᵢ−X̄)²/(n−1)满足E(S²)=σ²，是总体方差的无偏估计。s=√s²，但s本身通常不是σ的无偏估计；除以n−1并非总体方差定义。
derivation.en: Thus S²=Σ(Xᵢ−X̄)²/(n−1) is unbiased for σ². Define s=√s²; s itself is generally not unbiased for σ. The n−1 rule is not the population-variance definition.

scenario.zh: 数值8、12，分别视为完整总体与独立样本，计算两种方差和标准差。
scenario.en: Treat 8 and 12 first as a complete population and then as an iid sample. Calculate both variances and SDs.

steps.en: Both means are 10. The deviations are −2 and 2, with squared sum 8.
As a population: σ²=8/2=4 and σ=2.
As a sample: s²=8/(2−1)=8 and s≈2.828.

steps.zh: 两种答案来自不同问题；方差单位为原单位的平方，标准差单位与数据相同。
steps.en: These answer different questions. Variance has squared units; SD has the data's units.

kind.zh: 事件翻译与补事件恒等式
kind.en: Translating events and the complement identity

derivation.zh: at least表示包含下界，即X≥x；at most表示包含上界，即X≤x。given B表示把样本空间限制在B内，是条件定义而非代数定理。
derivation.en: “At least” includes the lower bound, X≥x; “at most” includes the upper bound, X≤x. “Given B” restricts the reference space to B.

derivation.zh: 事件{X≤x}与{X>x}没有重叠，合起来覆盖所有可能值。由可加性，P(X≤x)+P(X>x)=1。
derivation.en: The events {X≤x} and {X>x} are disjoint and exhaustive, so their probabilities sum to 1.

derivation.zh: 移项得P(X>x)=1−P(X≤x)。若问X≥x，则补事件是X<x，不能在离散情形随意替换。
derivation.en: Rearrange to obtain P(X>x)=1−P(X≤x). For X≥x the complement is X<x; discrete endpoints matter.

derivation.zh: 若X连续且在x无点质量，P(X=x)=0，才有P(X≥x)=P(X>x)。正态计算工具的累计选项给左尾，需要右尾时再取补。
derivation.en: If X has no point mass at x, then P(X≥x)=P(X>x). A normal CDF tool returns a left-tail probability; complement it for the right tail.

scenario.zh: X~N(100,225)，求至少115的概率；另掷公平骰子，求至少5点的概率。
scenario.en: For X~N(100,225), find P(X≥115). For a fair die, find the probability of at least 5.

steps.en: The normal SD is 15, so z=1.
For the die, {5,6} contains two outcomes, with probability 1/3.

steps.zh: 若错算P(骰子>5)，只剩{6}，概率1/6；这说明离散端点不能省略。
steps.en: Using >5 would leave only {6}, with probability 1/6. Discrete endpoints cannot be ignored.

kind.zh: 建模流程与期望值决策准则
kind.en: A modeling workflow and an expected-payoff decision rule

derivation.zh: “问题→数据→假设→模型→决策”是建模流程，不是可以代数证明的等式。先定义可选行动a和不可控状态s。
derivation.en: “Question → data → assumptions → model → decision” is a workflow, not an algebraic identity. Define actions a and uncontrollable states s.

derivation.zh: 用v(a,s)记录同单位收益，用p(s)表示状态概率，要求p(s)≥0且Σp(s)=1。
derivation.en: Record payoffs v(a,s) in consistent units and state probabilities p(s)≥0 summing to 1.

derivation.zh: 同一行动在各状态下的平均收益按概率加权：EMV(a)=Σp(s)v(a,s)。这是期望的定义。
derivation.en: The probability-weighted payoff is EMV(a)=Σp(s)v(a,s), by the definition of expectation.

derivation.zh: 若目标就是最大化期望货币收益、所有方案可行且不另计风险厌恶，则选择argmaxₐ EMV(a)。若目标换成效用或成本，准则也必须随之改变。
derivation.en: If the objective is expected monetary payoff, all actions are feasible and no separate risk preference is modeled, choose argmaxₐ EMV(a). Utility or cost objectives require a different criterion.

scenario.zh: 保底项目收益40；新项目以0.5概率赚100，以0.5概率亏20。按期望收益比较，并量化新项目波动。
scenario.en: A safe project pays 40. A new project pays 100 or −20 with equal probability. Compare expected payoffs and quantify the new project's variability.

steps.en: The new project's deviations from its mean are 60 and −60.

steps.zh: 仅按期望值两者并列，不能声称其中一个一定更好；风险准则需要另行说明。
steps.en: The expected-value criterion gives a tie. A preference requires an additional risk criterion.

kind.zh: 全期望与逆向归纳
kind.en: Total expectation and backward induction

derivation.zh: 在机会节点，设后续分支i以条件概率pᵢ发生，终点收益vᵢ已包含后续成本，Σpᵢ=1。
derivation.en: At a chance node, branch i occurs with conditional probability pᵢ and has payoff vᵢ including subsequent costs; the probabilities sum to 1.

derivation.zh: 将同一分支下的终点先求期望，再乘该分支概率后相加，等于逐个终点直接加权。这是分配律与全期望：E(V)=ΣP(i)E(V∣i)。
derivation.en: Averaging within each branch and then weighting branches equals directly weighting all leaves: E(V)=ΣP(i)E(V∣i), the law of total expectation.

derivation.zh: 若一个分支已到终点，其条件期望就是vᵢ，所以节点值EV=Σpᵢvᵢ。
derivation.en: At a terminal branch, the conditional expectation is vᵢ, giving EV=Σpᵢvᵢ.

derivation.zh: 在决策节点，分支是自己可选的行动，不是随机抽签。最大期望收益准则下取max，最小期望成本准则下取min；不能把选项收益无条件平均。
derivation.en: At a decision node branches are choices, not a random lottery. Maximize expected payoff or minimize expected cost; do not average the actions without a randomization rule.

derivation.zh: 从末端向前，用已求出的子树最优值替换子树。每一步比较都在同一个已知信息集合下进行，有限树重复此操作即可得到根节点最优值。
derivation.en: Work backward, replacing each subtree by its optimal value under the information then available. Repeating on a finite tree yields the optimal root value.

scenario.zh: 保底收益30；冒险成功概率0.6，成功收益80，失败收益−20。求机会节点值并作决策。
scenario.en: A safe action pays 30. A risky action pays 80 with probability 0.6 and −20 otherwise. Evaluate the chance node and choose.

steps.zh: 失败概率=1−0.6=0.4，两个分支概率之和为1。
steps.en: Failure probability is 0.4; the branch probabilities sum to 1.
The risky chance node has EV=48−8=40.

steps.zh: 决策节点max(30,40)=40，按该准则选冒险，期望优势40−30=10。
steps.en: Choose max(30,40)=40. The risky action has expected advantage 10 under this criterion.

kind.zh: 集合拆分与概率可加性
kind.en: Set decomposition and probability additivity

derivation.zh: 把A∪B拆成不重叠的三块：A但非B、B但非A、A∩B。对互不重叠事件，概率可以直接相加。
derivation.en: Split A∪B into three disjoint pieces: A only, B only and A∩B. Additivity applies to disjoint events.

derivation.zh: P(A)=P(A但非B)+P(A∩B)，P(B)=P(B但非A)+P(A∩B)。相加时交集被算两次。
derivation.en: P(A) and P(B) each contain the intersection, so adding them counts it twice.

derivation.zh: 减去一次交集，得到P(A∪B)=P(A)+P(B)−P(A∩B)。这个公式不要求独立。
derivation.en: Subtract one copy to obtain P(A∪B)=P(A)+P(B)−P(A∩B). Independence is not required.

derivation.zh: A与Aᶜ互不重叠且合为全集Ω，所以P(A)+P(Aᶜ)=P(Ω)=1，移项得P(Aᶜ)=1−P(A)。
derivation.en: A and Aᶜ partition the entire space, so P(A)+P(Aᶜ)=1 and P(Aᶜ)=1−P(A).

scenario.zh: 100人中40人买茶、30人买咖啡、10人都买。求至少买一种及两种都不买的概率。
scenario.en: Among 100 people, 40 buy tea, 30 buy coffee and 10 buy both. Find the probability of at least one and of neither.

steps.zh: 人数核对：只茶30、只咖啡20、都买10、都不买40，总和100。
steps.en: Check counts: 30 tea only, 20 coffee only, 10 both and 40 neither total 100.

kind.zh: 条件概率的定义与重新归一化
kind.en: Definition and renormalization of conditional probability

derivation.zh: 已知B发生后，只在B内分配概率；因此B在这个新空间的总概率必须为1，B外概率变为0。要求P(B)>0。
derivation.en: Given B, probability is reassigned within B. B must have conditional probability 1 and its exterior 0. Require P(B)>0.

derivation.zh: A在新空间对应A∩B，原来的概率质量为P(A∩B)。把B内所有质量同除以P(B)，总和恰好变为1。
derivation.en: The relevant part of A is A∩B, with original mass P(A∩B). Divide all masses within B by P(B) to normalize the total to 1.

derivation.zh: 由此定义P(A∣B)=P(A∩B)/P(B)。对等可能有限样本，可约掉共同分母，得到人数比N(A∩B)/N(B)。
derivation.en: This defines P(A∣B)=P(A∩B)/P(B). For equally likely finite outcomes it reduces to N(A∩B)/N(B).

derivation.zh: 两边乘P(B)也得到乘法法则P(A∩B)=P(A∣B)P(B)。分母对应已知条件，不能把A、B随意交换。
derivation.en: Multiplying by P(B) gives P(A∩B)=P(A∣B)P(B). The denominator is the given condition; reversing A and B changes the question.

scenario.zh: 100名顾客中40名会员，24名既是会员又买咖啡；咖啡购买者共有60名。分别计算两个方向的条件概率。
scenario.en: Of 100 customers, 40 are members, 60 buy coffee and 24 do both. Calculate both conditional directions.

steps.en: Let M denote membership and C buying coffee. The probabilities are 0.40, 0.60 and 0.24.
Both multiplication checks recover 0.24, although the conditional probabilities differ.

kind.zh: 条件概率与全概率的代入推导
kind.en: Substitution from conditional and total probability

derivation.zh: 先从定义开始：P(H∣E)=P(H∩E)/P(E)，要求P(E)>0。
derivation.en: Start with P(H∣E)=P(H∩E)/P(E), requiring P(E)>0.

derivation.zh: 乘法法则给分子P(H∩E)=P(H)P(E∣H)。
derivation.en: The multiplication rule gives the numerator P(H∩E)=P(H)P(E∣H).

derivation.zh: H与Hᶜ划分全集；E=(E∩H)∪(E∩Hᶜ)，两块不相交。
derivation.en: H and Hᶜ partition the space, splitting E into two disjoint pieces.

derivation.zh: 由可加性及乘法法则，P(E)=P(H)P(E∣H)+P(Hᶜ)P(E∣Hᶜ)。
derivation.en: Additivity and multiplication give P(E)=P(H)P(E∣H)+P(Hᶜ)P(E∣Hᶜ).

derivation.zh: 把分子和分母代回第一步，得到贝叶斯公式。若某先验为0，其对应条件概率可不单独定义，直接以该分块联合概率0处理。
derivation.en: Substitute both expressions into step 1 to obtain Bayes' formula. A zero-prior partition contributes zero joint mass without needing its conditional probability defined separately.

scenario.zh: 高需求先验0.10；高需求时积极信号概率0.80，否则为0.20。出现积极信号后，高需求概率是多少？
scenario.en: High demand has prior 0.10. A positive signal occurs with probability 0.80 under high demand and 0.20 otherwise. Find the posterior after a positive.

kind.zh: 独立的等价条件与互斥定义
kind.en: Equivalent independence conditions and disjointness

derivation.zh: 当P(B)>0，独立表示知道B不改变A的概率：P(A∣B)=P(A)。
derivation.en: For P(B)>0, independence means P(A∣B)=P(A).

derivation.zh: 代入条件概率定义：P(A∩B)/P(B)=P(A)，两边乘P(B)，得到P(A∩B)=P(A)P(B)。反向除回去也成立。
derivation.en: Substitute the conditional definition and multiply by P(B) to obtain P(A∩B)=P(A)P(B). Dividing reverses the argument.

derivation.zh: 一般情形直接以乘积等式定义独立，也能覆盖概率为0的事件，而无需对零概率事件作条件化。
derivation.en: The product identity defines independence generally, including zero-probability events, without conditioning on a null event.

derivation.zh: 互斥定义为A∩B=∅，所以交集概率0。若P(A)、P(B)都正，其乘积正，无法等于0，故正概率的互斥事件不独立。
derivation.en: Disjoint events have empty intersection and intersection probability 0. If both probabilities are positive, their product is positive, so such events are not independent.

scenario.zh: 公平骰子上A={1}、B={2}。另掷两枚独立公平硬币，C和D分别表示各自正面。比较互斥与独立。
scenario.en: For a fair die let A={1}, B={2}. For two independent fair coins, let C and D denote heads on each. Compare disjointness and independence.

steps.en: For the die, each probability is 1/6 and the intersection probability is 0.
Their product is 1/36, so they are disjoint but dependent.

steps.zh: 硬币四种等可能结果中只有HH在C∩D，概率1/4。
steps.en: Of four equally likely coin outcomes, only HH is in C∩D, with probability 1/4.

steps.zh: P(C)P(D)=1/2×1/2=1/4，故C、D独立；能同时发生，因此不互斥。
steps.en: P(C)P(D)=(1/2)×(1/2)=1/4=P(C∩D), proving independence. They can occur together and are not disjoint.

kind.zh: 概率质量函数的定义与公理约束
kind.en: Probability-mass definition and axiomatic constraints

derivation.zh: 离散随机变量X把结果映射成可列举数值xᵢ，定义pᵢ=P(X=xᵢ)。
derivation.en: A discrete random variable maps outcomes to countable values xᵢ. Define pᵢ=P(X=xᵢ).

derivation.zh: 概率非负公理直接给pᵢ≥0。不同取值事件互不重叠，所有可能取值事件合为全集。
derivation.en: Nonnegativity gives pᵢ≥0. Events for distinct possible values are disjoint and collectively exhaustive.

derivation.zh: 由可列可加性，Σpᵢ=P(全集)=1。只有同时满足非负与总和为1，才构成合法的概率质量函数。
derivation.en: Countable additivity gives Σpᵢ=1. Both nonnegativity and normalization are required for a valid mass function.

derivation.zh: 对任意目标取值集合S，事件{X∈S}由其中单点事件不交合成，故P(X∈S)=Σₓᵢ∈S pᵢ。
derivation.en: For a target set S, disjoint additivity gives P(X∈S)=Σₓᵢ∈S pᵢ.

scenario.zh: X可取0、1、2，相应概率为0.2、c、0.3。求c及P(X≥1)。
scenario.en: X takes 0, 1 and 2 with probabilities 0.2, c and 0.3. Find c and P(X≥1).

steps.zh: 三个概率均非负，且和为1，模型合法。
steps.en: All three probabilities are nonnegative and sum to 1.

kind.zh: 加权平均定义与期望线性性
kind.en: Weighted-average definition and linearity

derivation.zh: 离散期望定义为E(X)=Σxᵢpᵢ；一般要求E∣X∣<∞，避免无穷正负项造成未定义结果。
derivation.en: Define E(X)=Σxᵢpᵢ, assuming E∣X∣<∞ so positive and negative infinite parts do not conflict.

derivation.zh: 对于一对离散变量，联合概率记pᵢⱼ。E(aX+bY+c)=ΣᵢΣⱼ(axᵢ+byⱼ+c)pᵢⱼ。
derivation.en: For discrete variables with joint masses pᵢⱼ, E(aX+bY+c)=ΣᵢΣⱼ(axᵢ+byⱼ+c)pᵢⱼ.

derivation.zh: 按分配律拆开：aΣᵢxᵢΣⱼpᵢⱼ+bΣⱼyⱼΣᵢpᵢⱼ+cΣᵢΣⱼpᵢⱼ。
derivation.en: Distribute the sum into aΣᵢxᵢΣⱼpᵢⱼ+bΣⱼyⱼΣᵢpᵢⱼ+cΣᵢΣⱼpᵢⱼ.

derivation.zh: 联合概率按另一变量加总得到边际概率，总联合概率为1，所以结果=aE(X)+bE(Y)+c。此步不需要独立；连续情形把求和换成积分。
derivation.en: Summing joint masses gives marginal masses and total mass 1. The result is aE(X)+bE(Y)+c without independence. Integrals give the continuous counterpart.

scenario.en: X takes 0, 10 and 20 with probabilities 0.2, 0.5 and 0.3; E(Y)=4. Find E(X) and E(2X−3Y+5).

steps.zh: 算得22−12+5=15；即使X与Y相关，期望线性性仍成立。
steps.en: The answer is 15, whether or not X and Y are independent.

kind.zh: 平方偏差定义与缩放推导
kind.en: Squared-deviation definition and scaling

derivation.zh: μ=E(X)，有限方差定义Var(X)=E[(X−μ)²]；离散情形即Σ(xᵢ−μ)²pᵢ。
derivation.en: For μ=E(X), define Var(X)=E[(X−μ)²], equal to Σ(xᵢ−μ)²pᵢ in the discrete case.

derivation.zh: 展开平方并用期望线性性：E(X²−2μX+μ²)=E(X²)−2μ²+μ²=E(X²)−μ²。
derivation.en: Expand to obtain Var(X)=E(X²)−2μE(X)+μ²=E(X²)−μ².

derivation.zh: 令Y=aX+b，则E(Y)=aμ+b；Y−E(Y)=aX+b−aμ−b=a(X−μ)。
derivation.en: For Y=aX+b, E(Y)=aμ+b and Y−E(Y)=a(X−μ).

derivation.zh: 平方后取期望：Var(Y)=E[a²(X−μ)²]=a²Var(X)。b被消掉，因此平移不改变方差。
derivation.en: Square and take expectations: Var(Y)=a²Var(X). The constant b cancels, so a shift does not change variance.

derivation.zh: 标准差为非负平方根：SD(Y)=√[a²Var(X)]=∣a∣SD(X)。负a也必须取绝对值。
derivation.en: Taking the nonnegative square root gives SD(Y)=∣a∣SD(X), including negative a.

scenario.zh: X以各0.5概率取0或4，令Y=−3X+5。求X与Y的均值、方差、标准差。
scenario.en: X is 0 or 4 with equal probabilities. Let Y=−3X+5. Find both means, variances and SDs.

steps.zh: 直接核对：Y取5与−7，距均值−1分别为6与−6，平方平均也为36。
steps.en: Direct check: Y takes 5 and −7, with deviations ±6 from −1; their squared average is 36.

kind.zh: 计数推导与指示变量求矩
kind.en: Counting and indicator-variable moments

derivation.zh: 设n次独立伯努利试验，每次成功概率p。某个指定次序含k次成功、n−k次失败，其概率由独立性相乘为pᵏ(1−p)ⁿ⁻ᵏ。
derivation.en: For n independent Bernoulli trials with success probability p, a specified sequence with k successes has probability pᵏ(1−p)ⁿ⁻ᵏ.

derivation.zh: 选出k个成功位置：先有n(n−1)…(n−k+1)种有序选择，每个位置集合被k!种排列重复计数，故C(n,k)=n!/[k!(n−k)!]。
derivation.en: There are n(n−1)…(n−k+1) ordered choices of success positions. Divide by k! repeated orders to get C(n,k)=n!/[k!(n−k)!].

derivation.zh: 各次序互不重叠，概率相加，得到P(X=k)=C(n,k)pᵏ(1−p)ⁿ⁻ᵏ。边界p=0或1直接按确定性试验解释，避免0⁰歧义。
derivation.en: The sequences are disjoint, so P(X=k)=C(n,k)pᵏ(1−p)ⁿ⁻ᵏ. Treat p=0 or 1 as deterministic boundary cases.

derivation.zh: 令Iᵢ为第i次成功时取1、否则0的指示变量，则X=ΣIᵢ。E(Iᵢ)=p，E(Iᵢ²)=p，所以Var(Iᵢ)=p−p²。
derivation.en: Let Iᵢ indicate success. X=ΣIᵢ, E(Iᵢ)=E(Iᵢ²)=p and Var(Iᵢ)=p−p².

derivation.zh: 期望线性性给E(X)=np；独立使所有交叉协方差为0，因此Var(X)=Σp(1−p)=np(1−p)。
derivation.en: Linearity gives E(X)=np. Independence removes cross-covariances, giving Var(X)=np(1−p).

scenario.zh: 独立联系3名顾客，每位购买概率0.5。求恰好2人购买的概率、购买人数期望与方差。
scenario.en: Contact 3 independent customers with purchase probability 0.5 each. Find P(X=2), E(X) and Var(X).

steps.en: C(3,2)=3!/(2!1!)=3. Each relevant sequence has probability 0.5²×0.5=0.125.

steps.zh: E(X)=3×0.5=1.5人，这是模型均值，不要求是整数。
steps.en: E(X)=np=3×0.5=1.5 customers, a model mean that need not be an integer.

kind.zh: 中心化乘积与标准化
kind.en: Centered products and standardization

derivation.zh: 对有限二阶矩变量，定义Cov(X,Y)=E[(X−μₓ)(Y−μᵧ)]。展开为E(XY)−μₓμᵧ。
derivation.en: For finite second moments, define Cov(X,Y)=E[(X−μₓ)(Y−μᵧ)]=E(XY)−μₓμᵧ.

derivation.zh: 当σₓ、σᵧ都正，把变量各自标准化：U=(X−μₓ)/σₓ，V=(Y−μᵧ)/σᵧ。它们均值0、方差1。
derivation.en: For positive SDs, standardize U=(X−μₓ)/σₓ and V=(Y−μᵧ)/σᵧ; each has mean 0 and variance 1.

derivation.zh: 定义相关系数ρ=E(UV)，提取常数得到ρ=Cov(X,Y)/(σₓσᵧ)。这解释了为什么除以两个标准差：消除原单位。
derivation.en: Define ρ=E(UV). Extracting constants gives ρ=Cov(X,Y)/(σₓσᵧ), which removes units.

derivation.zh: 对任意实数t，0≤E[(U−tV)²]=1−2tρ+t²。取t=ρ，得到0≤1−ρ²，即−1≤ρ≤1。某个标准差为0时相关系数未定义。
derivation.en: For every real t, 0≤E[(U−tV)²]=1−2tρ+t². Setting t=ρ yields ρ²≤1. Correlation is undefined if either SD is zero.

scenario.zh: 两个等可能状态下(X,Y)为(0,6)、(4,0)。求协方差和相关系数。
scenario.en: Two equally likely states give (X,Y)=(0,6) or (4,0). Find covariance and correlation.

steps.zh: ρ=−6/(2×3)=−1，表示本例中完全负向线性关系。
steps.en: ρ=−6/(2×3)=−1, a perfect negative linear relationship in this example.

kind.zh: 期望线性性与方差展开
kind.en: Linearity and expansion of variance

derivation.zh: 令W=aX+bY，有限二阶矩保证所需期望存在。期望线性性给μw=aμₓ+bμᵧ，不需要独立。
derivation.en: For W=aX+bY with finite second moments, linearity gives μw=aμₓ+bμᵧ without independence.

derivation.zh: 中心化：W−μw=a(X−μₓ)+b(Y−μᵧ)。
derivation.en: Center W: W−μw=a(X−μₓ)+b(Y−μᵧ).

derivation.zh: 平方使用(A+B)²=A²+2AB+B²，得到a²(X−μₓ)²+2ab(X−μₓ)(Y−μᵧ)+b²(Y−μᵧ)²。
derivation.en: Squaring gives a²(X−μₓ)²+2ab(X−μₓ)(Y−μᵧ)+b²(Y−μᵧ)².

derivation.zh: 取期望：Var(W)=a²σₓ²+b²σᵧ²+2abCov(X,Y)。当两个标准差正时，代入Cov=ρσₓσᵧ得到页面公式。
derivation.en: Taking expectations gives Var(W)=a²σₓ²+b²σᵧ²+2abCov(X,Y). With positive SDs substitute Cov=ρσₓσᵧ.

derivation.zh: 若独立，E(XY)=E(X)E(Y)，协方差为0；否则不能直接丢掉交叉项。最后对总方差开平方才能得到总标准差。
derivation.en: Independence implies zero covariance; otherwise retain the cross-term. Take a square root only after computing total variance.

scenario.zh: μₓ=10、μᵧ=20、σₓ=2、σᵧ=3、ρ=0.5，W=2X−Y。求均值与标准差。
scenario.en: Let μₓ=10, μᵧ=20, σₓ=2, σᵧ=3, ρ=0.5 and W=2X−Y. Find its mean and SD.

steps.zh: SD(W)=√13≈3.6056；负权重使本例正协方差项降低总波动。
steps.en: SD(W)≈3.6056. The negative weight makes the positive covariance reduce total variance here.

kind.zh: 累积分布定义与区间相减
kind.en: CDF definition and subtraction of intervals

derivation.zh: 累积分布函数定义为F(x)=P(X≤x)。若存在密度f，则F(x)=∫₋∞ˣ f(t)dt，且总面积为1。
derivation.en: Define F(x)=P(X≤x). If density f exists, F(x)=∫₋∞ˣ f(t)dt and total area is 1.

derivation.zh: 当a<b，{X≤b}可拆成{X≤a}与{a<X≤b}两个不交事件。
derivation.en: For a<b, {X≤b} is the disjoint union of {X≤a} and {a<X≤b}.

derivation.zh: 可加性给F(b)=F(a)+P(a<X≤b)，移项得到区间概率F(b)−F(a)=∫ₐᵇf(t)dt。
derivation.en: Additivity gives P(a<X≤b)=F(b)−F(a)=∫ₐᵇf(t)dt.

derivation.zh: 左尾与右尾合为全集，因此P(X>x)=1−F(x)。连续密度下单点区间面积0，端点是否包含不改变概率；离散模型需保留端点。
derivation.en: The complementary right tail is 1−F(x). Under a density a point has zero area, so endpoint inclusion does not matter; it does for discrete masses.

scenario.zh: 某连续分布F(2)=0.3、F(5)=0.8。求2至5的概率，以及大于5的概率。
scenario.en: A continuous distribution has F(2)=0.3 and F(5)=0.8. Find the probability between 2 and 5 and above 5.

steps.zh: 左侧到5的总概率为0.8，其中到2为0.3。
steps.en: The probability up to 5 is 0.8, including 0.3 up to 2.

kind.zh: 矩形面积、积分与方差
kind.en: Rectangle area, integration and variance

derivation.zh: 假定a<b，均匀分布在[a,b]上的密度为常数c、区间外为0。总面积c(b−a)=1，所以c=1/(b−a)。
derivation.en: For a<b, a uniform density is constant c on [a,b] and zero elsewhere. Normalization c(b−a)=1 gives c=1/(b−a).

derivation.zh: 对区间内u≤v，概率是矩形面积P(u≤X≤v)=(v−u)/(b−a)。超出支持范围时先截到[a,b]；目标与支持不相交时概率为0。
derivation.en: For a≤u≤v≤b, the rectangle area is (v−u)/(b−a). Intersect with [a,b] for other targets; a disjoint target has probability 0.
Integrating gives E(X)=(b²−a²)/[2(b−a)]=(a+b)/2.

derivation.zh: E(X²)=∫ₐᵇx²/(b−a)dx=(b³−a³)/[3(b−a)]=(a²+ab+b²)/3。
derivation.en: Similarly E(X²)=(a²+ab+b²)/3.

derivation.zh: Var(X)=E(X²)−[E(X)]²，通分到12，分子为4(a²+ab+b²)−3(a²+2ab+b²)=a²−2ab+b²，所以Var(X)=(b−a)²/12。
derivation.en: Subtract the squared mean. With denominator 12, the numerator is a²−2ab+b², giving Var(X)=(b−a)²/12.

scenario.zh: 等待时间X~U(0,10)分钟。求不超过3分钟的概率、均值、方差和标准差。
scenario.en: For X~U(0,10) minutes, find P(X≤3), the mean, variance and SD.

steps.zh: 密度=1/(10−0)=0.1每分钟，目标宽度3分钟。
steps.en: Density=1/(10−0)=0.1 per minute; the target width is 3−0=3 minutes.

kind.zh: 分布定义、正态化与区间面积
kind.en: Distribution definition, normalization and interval area

derivation.zh: 正态是一种模型，不是所有数据的必然结论。标准正态密度设为φ(z)=c exp(−z²/2)。令I=∫₋∞∞ exp(−z²/2)dz。
derivation.en: A normal distribution is a model, not a consequence for all data. Set φ(z)=c exp(−z²/2) and I=∫₋∞∞ exp(−z²/2)dz.

derivation.zh: I²是平面上exp[−(x²+y²)/2]的积分。换极坐标，面积元dxdy=r dr dθ，得到I²=∫₀²πdθ ∫₀∞e^(−r²/2)r dr=2π×1，所以I=√(2π)，c=1/√(2π)。
derivation.en: Square I and use polar coordinates: I²=∫₀²πdθ∫₀∞exp(−r²/2)r dr=2π, so c=1/√(2π).

derivation.zh: φ关于0对称，所以E(Z)=0。又φ′(z)=−zφ(z)，分部积分给E(Z²)=∫z²φ(z)dz=[−zφ(z)]₋∞∞+∫φ(z)dz=1，所以Var(Z)=1。
derivation.en: Symmetry gives E(Z)=0. Since φ′(z)=−zφ(z), integration by parts gives E(Z²)=[−zφ(z)]₋∞∞+∫φ(z)dz=1, so Var(Z)=1.

derivation.zh: 令X=μ+σZ，σ>0，则E(X)=μ、Var(X)=σ²。换元z=(x−μ)/σ、dz=dx/σ，得到fX(x)=φ((x−μ)/σ)/σ；记作N(μ,σ²)。
derivation.en: For X=μ+σZ with σ>0, its mean is μ and variance σ². Change of variables gives fX(x)=φ((x−μ)/σ)/σ, denoted N(μ,σ²).
The interval μ±σ maps to −1≤Z≤1. Its probability is 2Φ(1)−1≈0.682689492, using numerical integration because Φ has no elementary antiderivative.

scenario.zh: 用时X~N(60,100)分钟，求50至70分钟内完成的概率；1000次独立任务中预期多少次在此范围？
scenario.en: Completion time is N(60,100) minutes. Find P(50≤X≤70) and the expected count among 1000 independent tasks.

steps.en: σ=√100=10. The standardized limits are (50−60)/10=−1 and (70−60)/10=1.
The CDF values are approximately 0.841344746 and 0.158655254.
Expected count ≈682.69; an actual count is a random integer, not guaranteed to equal 683.

kind.zh: 线性换元与概率不等式
kind.en: Linear change of variables and probability inequalities

derivation.zh: 对均值μ、正标准差σ的X，先减μ让中心为0，再除σ让标准差为1，定义Z=(X−μ)/σ。
derivation.en: Subtract μ to center X at zero and divide by positive σ to scale its SD to 1: Z=(X−μ)/σ.

derivation.zh: E(Z)=[E(X)−μ]/σ=0，Var(Z)=Var(X)/σ²=1。只有X本身正态时，Z才是精确标准正态；一般标准化并不改变分布形状为正态。
derivation.en: E(Z)=0 and Var(Z)=1. Z is exactly standard normal only if X is normal; standardization alone does not make arbitrary data normal.

derivation.zh: σ>0，故X>x等价于(X−μ)/σ>(x−μ)/σ，不等号方向保持不变。
derivation.en: Since σ>0, X>x is equivalent to Z>(x−μ)/σ without reversing the inequality.

derivation.zh: 若X正态，以Φ(z)=P(Z≤z)定义标准正态CDF，取补事件得到P(X>x)=1−Φ((x−μ)/σ)。
derivation.en: For normal X, use Φ(z)=P(Z≤z) and complement to obtain P(X>x)=1−Φ((x−μ)/σ).

steps.zh: 从方差225取标准差σ=15；目标是右尾。
steps.en: The SD is 15 and the target is a right tail.

steps.zh: 答案≈0.022750132=2.2750%；阈值高于均值，右尾小于0.5，方向核对正确。
steps.en: The result is about 0.022750132=2.2750%. A threshold above the mean gives a right tail below 0.5, consistent with the setup.

kind.zh: 反解累积概率与线性还原
kind.en: Inverting a CDF and reversing standardization

derivation.zh: 正态q分位数xq定义为P(X≤xq)=q，0<q<1且σ>0。标准化后Φ((xq−μ)/σ)=q。
derivation.en: For 0<q<1, the normal quantile satisfies P(X≤xq)=q, hence Φ((xq−μ)/σ)=q.

derivation.zh: 标准正态CDF连续严格递增，存在唯一逆值zq=Φ⁻¹(q)，即Φ(zq)=q。
derivation.en: The standard-normal CDF is continuous and strictly increasing, giving a unique zq=Φ⁻¹(q).

derivation.zh: 由(xq−μ)/σ=zq，两边乘σ、再加μ，得xq=μ+σzq。
derivation.en: Solve (xq−μ)/σ=zq by multiplying by σ and adding μ to obtain xq=μ+σzq.

derivation.zh: NORM.INV(q,mean,sd)是在计算这个逆函数；第三参数是标准差而不是方差。逆CDF通常用数值算法，不是靠初等代数直接求出zq。
derivation.en: NORM.INV(q,mean,sd) evaluates this inverse numerically. Its third argument is SD, not variance; zq is not generally available by elementary algebra.

scenario.zh: 需求X~N(100,100)，求95%分位点与整数库存配置。
scenario.en: Demand is N(100,100). Find the 95th percentile and an integer stock level.

steps.en: The inputs are μ=100, σ=10, q=0.95, with zq≈1.644853627.

steps.zh: 若库存必须为整数且希望该连续近似下左侧概率至少95%，向上取整为117。
steps.en: For integer stock with at least 95% left probability under this continuous model, round up to 117.

steps.zh: 代回117：z=1.7，Φ(1.7)≈0.955435，大于0.95；整数取整与模型近似应一并说明。
steps.en: At 117, z=1.7 and Φ(1.7)≈0.955435>0.95. State both rounding and the modeling approximation.

kind.zh: 线性组合的矩与正态闭合性
kind.en: Moments and normal closure under linear combinations

derivation.zh: 联合正态的一个等价定义是：每个实系数线性组合aX+bY都为正态（可包含零方差常量）。仅知道X、Y各自正态还不够。
derivation.en: An equivalent definition of joint normality is that every real linear combination is normal, possibly a degenerate constant. Normal marginals alone are insufficient.

derivation.zh: 令U=aX+bY+c，期望线性性给μu=aμₓ+bμᵧ+c。常数c不改变方差。
derivation.en: For U=aX+bY+c, linearity gives μu=aμₓ+bμᵧ+c. The constant does not affect variance.

derivation.zh: 把U减去均值并平方取期望：σu²=a²σₓ²+b²σᵧ²+2abCov(X,Y)，再代Cov=ρσₓσᵧ。
derivation.en: Center, square and average to get σu²=a²σₓ²+b²σᵧ²+2abρσₓσᵧ.

derivation.zh: 联合正态保证U正态，再用上述均值与方差唯一确定U~N(μu,σu²)。若σu²=0，U为常量，不使用除以标准差的公式。
derivation.en: Joint normality makes U normal; its moments determine N(μu,σu²). If σu²=0, U is constant and cannot be standardized by division.

derivation.zh: 正态矩母函数的来源：Mₓ(t)=∫e^(tx)fX(x)dx。指数配方tx−(x−μ)²/(2σ²)=μt+σ²t²/2−(x−μ−σ²t)²/(2σ²)。提取exp(μt+σ²t²/2)后，剩下是另一个正态密度的积分1，所以Mₓ(t)=exp(μt+σ²t²/2)。
derivation.en: To derive the normal MGF, integrate e^(tx)fX(x). Complete the square: tx−(x−μ)²/(2σ²)=μt+σ²t²/2−(x−μ−σ²t)²/(2σ²). The remaining normal density integrates to 1, giving Mₓ(t)=exp(μt+σ²t²/2).

derivation.zh: 独立正态为何满足此条件：它们的矩母函数在所有实t存在，独立给Mᵤ(t)=e^(ct)Mₓ(at)Mᵧ(bt)=exp[(aμₓ+bμᵧ+c)t+(a²σₓ²+b²σᵧ²)t²/2]，正是上述正态的矩母函数；由唯一性得到同一分布。
derivation.en: For independent normals, Mᵤ(t)=e^(ct)Mₓ(at)Mᵧ(bt)=exp[(aμₓ+bμᵧ+c)t+(a²σₓ²+b²σᵧ²)t²/2]. This is a normal MGF; MGF uniqueness establishes closure for this independent case.

scenario.zh: X、Y独立正态，均值40、60，标准差3、4。令U=X+Y+10，求分布及P(U≤115)。
scenario.en: X and Y are independent normals with means 40 and 60 and SDs 3 and 4. For U=X+Y+10, find its distribution and P(U≤115).

steps.en: Independence gives ρ=0, so variance=3²+4²=25 and SD=√25=5.
U~N(110,25), with variance as the second parameter.
The standardized cutoff is 1, giving probability ≈0.841344746.

kind.zh: 精确均值方差与极限定理推演
kind.en: Exact moments and a limit-theorem argument

derivation.zh: 条件：X₁,…,Xₙ独立同分布，E(Xᵢ)=μ，0<Var(Xᵢ)=σ²<∞。X̄=ΣXᵢ/n，所以E(X̄)=Σμ/n=μ。
derivation.en: Assume iid observations with mean μ and variance 0<σ²<∞. Then E(X̄)=Σμ/n=μ.

derivation.zh: 独立使交叉协方差为0，故Var(X̄)=Σσ²/n²=σ²/n，SD(X̄)=σ/√n。这两条对每个n都精确成立，不需要正态。
derivation.en: Independence gives Var(X̄)=σ²/n and SD(X̄)=σ/√n exactly for every n, without normality.

derivation.zh: 先看入门思路：平均仍围绕μ，但单个观测的正负偏差会部分抵消，波动按√n缩小。要证明形状趋于正态，需要下面的进阶工具；这不是“n≥30必然准确”的规则。
derivation.en: Intuitively averaging preserves the center while offsetting deviations reduces spread. Establishing a normal limiting shape needs the advanced argument below, not a universal n≥30 rule.

derivation.zh: 进阶工具定义：i²=−1，特征函数ψV(t)=E[e^(itV)]；它像分布的编码。取Y=(X−μ)/σ，则E(Y)=0、E(Y²)=1。
derivation.en: Advanced notation: i²=−1 and ψV(t)=E[e^(itV)] is a characteristic function encoding a distribution. Set Y=(X−μ)/σ, so E(Y)=0 and E(Y²)=1.

derivation.zh: 有限二阶矩给ψY(u)=1−u²/2+o(u²)。理由：e^(iv)=1+iv−v²/2+v²r(v)，r(v)→0且在实数轴有界；令v=uY，余项除以u²后为E[Y²r(uY)]，由支配收敛趋于0。
derivation.en: Finite second moment gives ψY(u)=1−u²/2+o(u²): write e^(iv)=1+iv−v²/2+v²r(v), with bounded r(v)→0. Dominated convergence applied to E[Y²r(uY)] makes the scaled remainder vanish.

derivation.zh: 令Zn=ΣYᵢ/√n。独立给ψZn(t)=[ψY(t/√n)]ⁿ=[1−t²/(2n)+o(1/n)]ⁿ→exp(−t²/2)，使用(1+a/n+o(1/n))ⁿ→eᵃ。
derivation.en: For Zn=ΣYᵢ/√n, independence yields ψZn(t)=[1−t²/(2n)+o(1/n)]ⁿ→exp(−t²/2).

derivation.zh: exp(−t²/2)是N(0,1)的特征函数，且在0连续。应用特征函数连续性定理，Zn依分布收敛到N(0,1)，所以对每个实z，P(Zn≤z)→Φ(z)。这里明确使用支配收敛与连续性定理作为分析学前提。
derivation.en: The limit is the standard-normal characteristic function and is continuous at zero. The characteristic-function continuity theorem yields Zn⇒N(0,1), hence P(Zn≤z)→Φ(z). Dominated convergence and the continuity theorem are stated analytical prerequisites.

derivation.zh: 于是(X̄−μ)/(σ/√n)对足够合适的n可用标准正态近似；有限n误差仍取决于总体形状。若原总体正态，则线性组合本身正态，无需等极限。
derivation.en: Thus the standardized sample mean admits a normal approximation when adequate. Finite-n accuracy depends on the population. For an originally normal population the result is exact at every n.

scenario.zh: μ=10、σ=6，独立同分布抽取n=36。求均值标准误，并在正态近似适用时求P(X̄>12)。
scenario.en: Take n=36 iid observations from a population with μ=10 and σ=6. Find the mean's SE and approximate P(X̄>12) when the normal approximation is adequate.

steps.zh: 近似右尾1−Φ(2)≈0.022750132；若总体强偏或重尾，不能仅凭n=36保证这个精度。
steps.en: The approximate tail is 0.022750132. A strongly skewed or heavy-tailed population may make this inaccurate even at n=36.

kind.zh: 伯努利和的极限与连续性修正
kind.en: A Bernoulli-sum limit and continuity correction

derivation.zh: X=ΣIᵢ是n个独立同分布Bernoulli(p)之和。固定0<p<1时，E(X)=np、Var(X)=np(1−p)。
derivation.en: X is a sum of iid Bernoulli(p) variables. For fixed 0<p<1, its mean is np and variance np(1−p).

derivation.zh: 应用中心极限定理，(X−np)/√[np(1−p)]依分布趋于N(0,1)。反标准化得到匹配均值与方差的近似Y~N(np,np(1−p))。
derivation.en: The CLT standardizes the sum to a standard-normal limit, giving the moment-matched approximation Y~N(np,np(1−p)).

derivation.zh: 整数j可画成从j−0.5到j+0.5的宽1柱。事件X≤k包含到k这一整根柱，所以用连续面积到k+0.5来近似。
derivation.en: Represent integer j by a unit-width bar from j−0.5 to j+0.5. Including all of bar k suggests the continuous cutoff k+0.5 for X≤k.

derivation.zh: 因此P(X≤k)≈Φ((k+0.5−np)/√[np(1−p)])。0.5是离散柱与连续面积对齐的修正，不是恒等式或对所有参数的误差保证。
derivation.en: Hence P(X≤k)≈Φ((k+0.5−np)/√[np(1−p)]). The 0.5 adjustment is approximate, not an identity or a universal error guarantee.

derivation.zh: np与n(1−p)都足够大时通常较适合；本页用二者至少10作入门检查，尾部仍可能不准。p为0或1是确定性情形，应直接精确计算。
derivation.en: Both np and n(1−p) should be sufficiently large; 10 each is an introductory check here, not a guarantee of tail accuracy. Treat p=0 or 1 exactly.

scenario.zh: X~Bin(100,0.5)，近似求P(X≤55)，并与二项精确求和核对。
scenario.en: Approximate P(X≤55) for Bin(100,0.5), then compare with the exact binomial sum.

steps.en: np=n(1−p)=50. The mean is 50, variance=100×0.5×0.5=25 and SD=√25=5.
The exact sum is about 0.864373488, an absolute difference of about 0.000039549 here.

kind.zh: 抽样设计定义与样本均值无偏性
kind.en: Sampling definitions and unbiasedness of a sample mean

derivation.zh: “总体参数→抽样→样本统计量”是对象关系，不是数值等式。先固定想研究的总体，再说明样本怎样进入数据。
derivation.en: “Population parameter → sampling → statistic” describes objects, not a numerical identity. Specify the population and the selection mechanism first.

derivation.zh: 若每个Xᵢ都来自目标总体且E(Xᵢ)=μ，样本均值X̄=ΣXᵢ/n由定义得到。
derivation.en: If each Xᵢ comes from the target population and E(Xᵢ)=μ, define X̄=ΣXᵢ/n.

derivation.zh: 期望线性性给E(X̄)=ΣE(Xᵢ)/n=nμ/n=μ；这一步只用相同边际均值，不要求独立。独立性是后续σ²/n方差公式所需。
derivation.en: Linearity gives E(X̄)=μ using equal marginal means. Independence is not needed for this mean identity, but is needed for the usual σ²/n variance formula.

derivation.zh: 若抽样偏向某类人，使E(Xᵢ)=μsample≠μ，则E(X̄)=μsample，偏差=μsample−μ。增加n本身不会把这项系统偏差改成0。
derivation.en: If selection changes the observation mean to μsample≠μ, then E(X̄)=μsample and bias is μsample−μ. Increasing n does not itself remove that bias.

scenario.zh: 小总体账单为40、50、60元。每次等概率抽1户（可放回）。求总体均值及单次抽样估计的期望；再比较永远只抽60元那户的偏差。
scenario.en: A population has bills 40, 50 and 60. Sample one household uniformly with replacement. Find the population mean and estimator expectation, then the bias if only the 60 household is selected.

steps.zh: 等概率抽1户时，估计值可能40、50、60，各概率1/3。
steps.en: The estimate takes 40, 50 or 60 with probability 1/3 each.

steps.zh: 若总抽60元那户，估计期望60，偏差60−50=10元；重复再多次也仍偏10元。
steps.en: Selecting only the 60 household gives expectation 60 and bias=60−50=10, unchanged by repetition under the same selection rule.

kind.zh: 参数、估计量与估计值的定义
kind.en: Definitions of parameter, estimator and estimate

derivation.zh: 参数μ描述目标总体，抽样之前它已固定但通常未知。估计量是把随机样本映射成一个数的规则，例如X̄=ΣXᵢ/n。
derivation.en: The parameter μ is fixed but usually unknown. An estimator maps a random sample to a number, for example X̄=ΣXᵢ/n.

derivation.zh: “随机”来自尚未观测的Xᵢ。拿到实际数据x₁,…,xₙ后，代入同一规则得到固定数值x̄=Σxᵢ/n，称为本次估计值。
derivation.en: Randomness comes from the unobserved Xᵢ. After observing x₁,…,xₙ, substitution produces the fixed observed estimate x̄.

derivation.zh: 若样本各自均值为μ，则E(X̄)=Σμ/n=μ，这是均值估计量无偏的推导；不等于每份样本的x̄都等于μ。
derivation.en: If every observation has mean μ, E(X̄)=Σμ/n=μ. This establishes unbiasedness, not equality between each estimate and μ.

derivation.zh: 若还独立同分布且方差σ²有限，则Var(X̄)=σ²/n；估计值与不确定性必须分开报告。
derivation.en: If observations are also iid with finite variance, Var(X̄)=σ²/n. Report the estimate separately from its uncertainty.

scenario.zh: 抽到三户账单40、50、60元；为练习假设总体σ=12元。求本次点估计和其抽样标准误。
scenario.en: Observe bills 40, 50 and 60. For this exercise assume population SD 12. Find the point estimate and its sampling SE.

steps.en: The estimator is X̄=(X₁+X₂+X₃)/3; substitute the observed bills.

steps.zh: 50是一次样本的估计；6.9282描述重复抽样时估计量的波动，不是总体均值的已知误差。
steps.en: 50 is one estimate; 6.9282 describes sampling variability, not the known realized estimation error.

kind.zh: 均值方差缩放与未知σ的代入
kind.en: Variance scaling for a mean and estimating unknown σ

derivation.zh: 独立同分布观测满足E(Xᵢ)=μ、Var(Xᵢ)=σ²<∞。令X̄=(1/n)ΣXᵢ。
derivation.en: Assume iid observations with finite variance σ² and let X̄=(1/n)ΣXᵢ.

derivation.zh: 常数缩放方差要平方：Var(X̄)=(1/n²)Var(ΣXᵢ)。
derivation.en: Variance scales by the square: Var(X̄)=(1/n²)Var(ΣXᵢ).

derivation.zh: 展开和的方差为ΣVar(Xᵢ)+2Σᵢ<ⱼCov(Xᵢ,Xⱼ)。独立使每个协方差为0，得到nσ²。
derivation.en: Expand the variance of the sum. Independence makes every cross-covariance zero, leaving nσ².

derivation.zh: 所以Var(X̄)=nσ²/n²=σ²/n，标准误按定义是这个方差的平方根：SE(X̄)=σ/√n，而不是σ/n。
derivation.en: Thus Var(X̄)=σ²/n. Its square root defines SE(X̄)=σ/√n, not σ/n.

derivation.zh: σ未知时，以样本标准差s替代，得到估计标准误s/√n。这是代入估计，不意味着s=σ，也不意味着标准误估计无偏。
derivation.en: When σ is unknown, use s/√n as an estimated SE. This plug-in step does not assert s=σ or unbiasedness of the estimated SE.

scenario.zh: 总体消费标准差20元，独立抽100人；再独立抽400人。分别求均值标准误；若首个样本s=18，估计SE是多少？
scenario.en: Population spending SD is 20. Compare SEs for independent samples of 100 and 400; if the first sample has s=18, find its estimated SE.

steps.zh: 样本量变4倍，标准误变1/2；个人消费标准差仍20元。
steps.en: Quadrupling sample size halves SE; individual SD remains 20.

steps.zh: σ未知而s=18时，估计SE=18/10=1.8元，需标为估计值。
steps.en: With unknown σ and s=18, estimated SE=18/√100=18/10=1.8; label it estimated.

kind.zh: 由枢轴概率反解区间
kind.en: Inverting a pivotal probability into an interval

derivation.zh: 设估计量θ̂满足Z=(θ̂−θ)/SE，其参考分布对参数θ不变，且SE>0。选择临界值c>0使P(−c≤Z≤c)=1−α。
derivation.en: Suppose Z=(θ̂−θ)/SE has a parameter-free reference distribution, with SE>0. Choose c>0 so P(−c≤Z≤c)=1−α.

derivation.zh: 对每份样本把不等式同乘正数SE：−cSE≤θ̂−θ≤cSE。若SE为随机正数，逐样本的等价变形仍成立。
derivation.en: Multiply by positive SE: −cSE≤θ̂−θ≤cSE. This is a samplewise equivalence even for a random positive SE.

derivation.zh: 分别整理左右两端：θ̂−cSE≤θ≤θ̂+cSE。因此区间为估计值±临界值×标准误。
derivation.en: Rearranging gives θ̂−cSE≤θ≤θ̂+cSE, the estimate ± critical value × SE form.

derivation.zh: 因为事件在每步都等价，构造区间覆盖固定θ的概率是1−α。若第一步分布只是近似，覆盖率也只是近似；并非所有分布的区间都对称。
derivation.en: Equivalent events preserve coverage 1−α. An approximate pivot gives approximate coverage, and not all interval procedures are symmetric.

derivation.zh: 观测后上下限固定。95%指重复抽样程序的长期覆盖率，不是把固定参数重新当作随机数的概率，也不保证100次恰好覆盖95次。
derivation.en: After observation the endpoints are fixed. 95% is the procedure's long-run coverage, not a new probability distribution for the fixed parameter or a guarantee of 95 in 100.

scenario.zh: 独立正态样本，σ已知10元、n=100、x̄=50元，构造95%均值区间。
scenario.en: For an independent normal sample with known σ=10, n=100 and x̄=50, construct a 95% mean interval.

steps.zh: 全宽约3.9199元；区间估计的是总体均值，不是95%个体账单所在范围。
steps.en: The full width is about 3.9199. This estimates the population mean, not the range containing 95% of individual bills.

kind.zh: z枢轴、t枢轴与不等式反解
kind.en: z and t pivots and interval inversion

derivation.zh: 假设X₁,…,Xₙ独立正态，均值μ、方差σ²>0。均值精确服从N(μ,σ²/n)，故Z=(X̄−μ)/(σ/√n)~N(0,1)。
derivation.en: For iid normal observations with variance σ²>0, X̄~N(μ,σ²/n), so Z=(X̄−μ)/(σ/√n) is standard normal.

derivation.zh: 取z*=Φ⁻¹(1−α/2)，对称性给P(−z*≤Z≤z*)=1−α。乘σ/√n并整理μ，得X̄±z*σ/√n。
derivation.en: Take z*=Φ⁻¹(1−α/2). Invert the central probability to obtain X̄±z*σ/√n.

derivation.zh: σ未知时不能简单声称把σ换s后仍是z。令Zᵢ=(Xᵢ−μ)/σ，各自独立标准正态；选正交坐标变换，把第一坐标取为ΣZᵢ/√n。
derivation.en: Replacing σ by s does not preserve a z distribution. Start with iid standard normals Zᵢ and choose an orthogonal transformation with first coordinate ΣZᵢ/√n.

derivation.zh: 正交变换保持ΣZᵢ²和雅可比绝对值1，变换后联合密度仍是∏φ，故新坐标独立标准正态。第一坐标是Z；其余n−1个坐标平方和V=Σ(Xᵢ−X̄)²/σ²=(n−1)S²/σ²。
derivation.en: Orthogonal transformation preserves squared length and unit absolute Jacobian, so the transformed density still factors into standard normals. The first coordinate is Z; the others have squared sum V=(n−1)S²/σ².

derivation.zh: V是n−1个独立标准正态平方和，按定义服从χ²ₙ₋₁，并与Z独立。按Student t分布的定义，T=Z/√[V/(n−1)]~tₙ₋₁。
derivation.en: V is χ²ₙ₋₁ by definition and independent of Z. The Student t definition gives T=Z/√[V/(n−1)]~tₙ₋₁.

derivation.zh: 代回Z与V，约掉σ，得到T=(X̄−μ)/(S/√n)。取t*=t₁₋α/₂,ₙ₋₁，对中心概率同样反解，得到X̄±t*S/√n。
derivation.en: Substitute and cancel σ to get T=(X̄−μ)/(S/√n). Invert its central probability with t* to obtain X̄±t*S/√n.

derivation.zh: 正态独立样本下上述覆盖是精确的；非正态情况下通常需要适当大样本近似，强偏、异常值与依赖可能破坏结果。
derivation.en: These are exact under iid normal sampling. Nonnormal cases require justified approximation; severe skew, outliers or dependence may invalidate it.

scenario.zh: n=25、x̄=50、s=10，独立正态样本，求95%均值区间；再比较σ已知为10的区间。
scenario.en: For an iid normal sample with n=25, x̄=50 and s=10, construct a 95% mean interval and compare it with known σ=10.

steps.en: For unknown σ, df=25−1=24 and estimated SE=10/√25=2.
With known σ=10 the z margin is about 3.91992797, yielding [46.0801,53.9199], narrower in this comparison.

kind.zh: 伯努利均值与Wald近似区间
kind.en: A Bernoulli mean and the Wald approximation

derivation.zh: 把每个回答写成独立Bernoulli(p)变量Iᵢ：赞成为1，否则0。成功数x是ΣIᵢ的观测值，样本比例p̂=x/n就是这些0、1的样本均值。
derivation.en: Encode iid responses as Bernoulli(p) indicators. The observed count is x and p̂=x/n is their sample mean.

derivation.zh: E(Iᵢ)=p，Var(Iᵢ)=p(1−p)，所以E(p̂)=p，Var(p̂)=p(1−p)/n，真实标准误为√[p(1−p)/n]。
derivation.en: Thus E(p̂)=p and Var(p̂)=p(1−p)/n, giving true SE √[p(1−p)/n].

derivation.zh: p未知，Wald方法代入p̂估计标准误：SEhat=√[p̂(1−p̂)/n]。大样本下标准化比例近似标准正态。
derivation.en: The Wald method estimates the unknown p by p̂ in the SE. Under a suitable large-sample approximation the standardized proportion is approximately normal.

derivation.zh: 把估计标准误视为本次样本已计算出的量，从−z*≤(p̂−p)/SEhat≤z*反解，得到p̂±z*SEhat。代入与正态化都引入近似，不是精确覆盖。
derivation.en: Treat the computed SE as positive and invert −z*≤(p̂−p)/SEhat≤z* to get p̂±z*SEhat. Both plug-in estimation and normal approximation make coverage approximate.

derivation.zh: 要检查独立随机抽样及足够成功、失败数。本页采用各至少10的入门检查；靠近0或1时Wald区间可能很差甚至越界，应改用Wilson或精确法，不能仅截断就声称修复覆盖。
derivation.en: Check independent random sampling and adequate successes and failures, using 10 each here as a basic check. Near 0 or 1 the Wald interval can fail; consider Wilson or exact methods rather than claiming clipping fixes coverage.

scenario.zh: 随机独立调查100人，60人赞成。求95% Wald比例区间。
scenario.en: In an independent random survey of 100 people, 60 approve. Find a 95% Wald interval.

kind.zh: 从误差界不等式反解n
kind.en: Solving a margin-of-error inequality for n

derivation.zh: 均值z区间半宽M=z*σ/√n。规划要求M≤L，给定L>0、σ>0及临界值z*>0，先乘√n，再除L，得到√n≥z*σ/L。
derivation.en: A mean z interval has half-width M=z*σ/√n. Requiring M≤L with positive inputs gives √n≥z*σ/L.

derivation.zh: 两侧非负，平方保持方向：n≥(z*σ/L)²。n必须为整数，所以最小n=ceil[(z*σ/L)²]，ceil意为向上取整。
derivation.en: Square the nonnegative sides to obtain n≥(z*σ/L)². The smallest integer is its ceiling.

derivation.zh: 比例规划用预先选定p*估计未知波动，半宽M≈z*√[p*(1−p*)/n]。同样平方并解出n≥z*²p*(1−p*)/L²。
derivation.en: For a proportion, plan with p* and M≈z*√[p*(1−p*)/n]. Solve to obtain n≥z*²p*(1−p*)/L².

derivation.zh: 无先验信息时p(1−p)=1/4−(p−1/2)²≤1/4，故取p*=0.5给最保守的该近似样本量。
derivation.en: Since p(1−p)=1/4−(p−1/2)²≤1/4, p*=0.5 gives the most conservative sample size within this approximation.

derivation.zh: 这些是独立抽样z方法的规划公式。σ只能估计时需说明规划值；t临界值随n变化，要迭代；有限总体、聚类与无应答还需另作设计调整。
derivation.en: These plan iid z intervals. A guessed σ is a planning input; t critical values depend on n and require iteration. Finite populations, clustering and nonresponse need design adjustments.

scenario.zh: 用规划临界值z*=1.96：均值规划σ=10、L=2；比例无先验信息、L=0.05。各至少需要多少有效独立观测？
scenario.en: Use planning critical value 1.96. For a mean use σ=10, L=2; for a proportion use no prior information and L=0.05. Find both sample sizes.

steps.en: Round up to 97. Its half-width is about 1.9901; n=96 gives about 2.0004 and fails.
Round up to 385, giving planned half-width about 0.049946≤0.05.

kind.zh: 假设构造规则与统计量计算
kind.en: Constructing hypotheses and calculating a statistic

derivation.zh: H₀与Hₐ是对未知总体参数的主张，不能由样本代数“证明”其真假。先从问题决定要检验较小、较大还是任意差异。
derivation.en: H₀ and Hₐ are claims about a population parameter, not identities whose truth can be proved by sample algebra. Prespecify the direction.

derivation.zh: 设业务基准为μ₀。“小于”对应Hₐ:μ<μ₀，“大于”对应Hₐ:μ>μ₀，“不同”对应Hₐ:μ≠μ₀。
derivation.en: A benchmark μ₀ gives alternatives μ<μ₀, μ>μ₀ or μ≠μ₀ for lower, higher or different claims.

derivation.zh: 双侧通常写H₀:μ=μ₀。单侧完整原假设可写μ≥μ₀或μ≤μ₀；本课常用其边界μ=μ₀计算参考分布，在标准单调检验中该边界给最不利误拒概率。
derivation.en: For two sides use H₀:μ=μ₀. A one-sided null can be μ≥μ₀ or μ≤μ₀; the course uses the boundary for the reference calculation, which is least favorable for the standard monotone tests.

derivation.zh: 为量化样本与边界差异，用z=(x̄−μ₀)/(σ/√n)或合适的t统计量。小于检验看左尾，大于检验看右尾，不同看双尾；方向必须在看数据前确定。
derivation.en: Quantify departure using an appropriate z or t statistic. Lower claims use the left tail, higher the right and unequal both; select the direction before seeing data.

scenario.zh: 检验流程均值是否小于10分钟。已知σ=2，独立正态样本n=25、x̄=9.2，α=0.05。写假设并作左尾z检验。
scenario.en: Test whether mean process time is below 10. Known σ=2, iid normal n=25, x̄=9.2 and α=0.05. Write hypotheses and perform a left-tail z test.

steps.en: Use Hₐ:μ<10 and H₀:μ≥10, calculating at the boundary 10.

steps.zh: p<0.05，拒绝原假设，有证据支持平均耗时低于10分钟；不代表已证明任何一次耗时都低于10。
steps.en: Reject at 0.05, supporting a lower mean, not a claim that every individual time is below 10.

kind.zh: 在不同真实状态下定义概率
kind.en: Probabilities under different true states

derivation.zh: 先固定检验规则，令R为拒绝H₀的事件。简单原假设下，一类错误概率定义为Pθ₀(R)；复合原假设的水平α要求supθ∈H₀ Pθ(R)≤α。
derivation.en: Fix a rejection event R. Type I error at a simple null is Pθ₀(R); level α for a composite null requires supθ∈H₀ Pθ(R)≤α.

derivation.zh: 选定一个具体备择真实参数θ₁，二类错误概率β(θ₁)=Pθ₁(Rᶜ)，即该备择下没拒绝。
derivation.en: At a specified alternative θ₁, define β(θ₁)=Pθ₁(Rᶜ).

derivation.zh: 同一个备择世界里R与Rᶜ互为补事件，所以Pθ₁(R)+β(θ₁)=1，功效Power(θ₁)=Pθ₁(R)=1−β(θ₁)。
derivation.en: Within that alternative world, R and Rᶜ are complements, giving Power(θ₁)=1−β(θ₁).

derivation.zh: α与β使用不同真实状态，不是同一分布下互补的两件事，不能写α+β=1。
derivation.en: α and β refer to different true states, so α+β is not generally 1.

derivation.zh: 例如已知σ的右尾均值z检验，R={X̄>μ₀+z₁₋α σ/√n}。若真实均值μ₁，则β(μ₁)=Φ((μ₀+z₁₋α σ/√n−μ₁)/(σ/√n))，由对X̄的左尾标准化得到。
derivation.en: For a known-σ right-tail mean test, reject above c=μ₀+z₁₋α σ/√n. Under true μ₁, standardizing the nonrejection event gives β(μ₁)=Φ((c−μ₁)/(σ/√n)).

scenario.zh: 独立正态观测，σ=10、n=100，检验H₀:μ≤50对Hₐ:μ>50，α=0.05。真实μ=53时求β与功效。
scenario.en: For iid normal observations with σ=10 and n=100, test μ≤50 against μ>50 at α=0.05. Find β and power if true μ=53.

steps.zh: 功效=1−β≈0.912315，约91.23%；该β只针对μ=53，不适用于所有备择。
steps.en: Power is approximately 0.912315, or 91.23%, specifically at μ=53.
At the boundary μ=50, the false-rejection probability is 1−Φ(1.644853627)=0.05, checking the Type I level.

kind.zh: 在原假设下中心化与t比值
kind.en: Centering under the null and forming a t ratio

derivation.zh: 在H₀边界μ=μ₀下，独立正态样本均值X̄~N(μ₀,σ²/n)。从均值减去μ₀，再除以其正标准差σ/√n，得到z统计量。
derivation.en: At the null boundary, X̄~N(μ₀,σ²/n) under iid normal sampling. Centering and scaling yields the z statistic.

derivation.zh: 因此Z=(X̄−μ₀)/(σ/√n)~N(0,1)。分母是样本均值的标准差，不能用个体σ直接替代。
derivation.en: Thus Z=(X̄−μ₀)/(σ/√n) is standard normal. The denominator is the mean's SD, not the individual σ.

derivation.zh: σ未知时，由正态样本的正交分解，V=(n−1)S²/σ²是n−1个独立标准正态平方和，且与Z独立；均值区间的推导中给出了坐标分解过程。
derivation.en: For unknown σ, the normal-sample orthogonal decomposition gives V=(n−1)S²/σ²~χ²ₙ₋₁ independent of Z; the mean-CI derivation shows this decomposition.

derivation.zh: 按t分布定义，T=Z/√[V/(n−1)]。代入并约去σ，得到T=(X̄−μ₀)/(S/√n)，自由度n−1。
derivation.en: By the t definition, T=Z/√[V/(n−1)]. Substitution cancels σ, yielding T=(X̄−μ₀)/(S/√n) with n−1 degrees of freedom.

derivation.zh: 观测值z或t只是横轴位置。p值需要按预定备择方向在相应参考分布上求尾面积；非正态时必须另行论证近似有效性。
derivation.en: An observed z or t is a location, not a p-value. Compute the prespecified tail in its reference distribution; nonnormal sampling requires a justified approximation.

scenario.zh: n=25、x̄=52、s=10，独立正态样本。双侧检验μ₀=50，α=0.05；再比较σ已知为10的z统计量。
scenario.en: For iid normal n=25, x̄=52 and s=10, test μ₀=50 two-sided at 0.05. Compare the z statistic if σ is known to be 10.

steps.en: Use t for unknown σ: SE=10/√25=2 and df=25−1=24.

steps.zh: 双侧临界值约±2.063898562，∣1∣较小，所以不拒绝；数值t尾积分给p≈0.32728688。
steps.en: The two-sided critical values are about ±2.063898562, so do not reject. Numerical t-tail integration gives p≈0.32728688.

steps.zh: 若σ已知为10，z也等于1，但双侧标准正态p≈0.31731051；同一统计量数值并不意味着同一参考分布或p值。
steps.en: With known σ=10, z is also 1, but the normal two-sided p≈0.31731051. Equal statistic values do not imply equal p-values.

kind.zh: 尾事件定义、对称性与阈值规则
kind.en: Tail events, symmetry and a threshold rule

derivation.zh: 固定检验统计量与预先确定的备择。p值在H₀参考分布下计算，累加至少与观测值同样极端的统计量结果，而不是给H₀赋予概率。
derivation.en: Fix the statistic and prespecified alternative. A p-value sums reference-null outcomes at least as extreme as observed; it does not assign a probability to H₀.

derivation.zh: 标准正态右尾：p=P(Z≥zobs)=1−Φ(zobs)；左尾：p=P(Z≤zobs)=Φ(zobs)，因为连续分布没有端点质量。
derivation.en: For standard normal tests, right-tail p=1−Φ(zobs) and left-tail p=Φ(zobs); endpoint equality has zero mass.

derivation.zh: 双侧以∣Z∣衡量极端。事件∣Z∣≥∣zobs∣分成两个不相交尾部：Z≥∣zobs∣和Z≤−∣zobs∣。
derivation.en: For two sides, ∣Z∣≥∣zobs∣ splits into the disjoint upper and lower tails.

derivation.zh: 由正态对称性Φ(−a)=1−Φ(a)，两个尾部各为1−Φ(∣zobs∣)，相加得到p=2[1−Φ(∣zobs∣)]。非对称或离散检验不能不加判断套用“双倍单尾”。
derivation.en: Normal symmetry makes both tails equal to 1−Φ(∣zobs∣), giving twice that value. Do not blindly double a one-tail p for asymmetric or discrete tests.

derivation.zh: 在该连续精确检验中，p≤α等价于∣Z∣≥Φ⁻¹(1−α/2)，其H₀概率为α，因此得到水平α的拒绝规则。p>α表示证据不足，不是证明H₀。
derivation.en: Here p≤α is equivalent to crossing the two-sided critical value, an event with null probability α. Nonrejection means insufficient evidence, not proof of H₀.

scenario.zh: 观察到z=2，分别求左尾、右尾、双尾p；按预先指定双尾检验、α=0.05作结论。
scenario.en: For z=2 calculate left-, right- and two-tail p-values. Make the decision for a prespecified two-sided test at 0.05.

steps.zh: 预定双尾p<0.05，拒绝H₀；三个p对应三个不同备择，不能算完后挑最小的来报告。
steps.en: The prespecified two-sided test rejects. These three values correspond to different alternatives; do not select the smallest after seeing data.

kind.zh: 在零假设下求比例方差
kind.en: Deriving a proportion's variance under the null

derivation.zh: 独立Bernoulli(p)样本的比例p̂=ΣIᵢ/n。H₀给p=p₀，所以E₀(p̂)=p₀。
derivation.en: For iid Bernoulli observations p̂=ΣIᵢ/n. Under H₀, p=p₀, so E₀(p̂)=p₀.

derivation.zh: H₀下每个Iᵢ的方差是p₀(1−p₀)，独立求和后除以n²，得Var₀(p̂)=np₀(1−p₀)/n²=p₀(1−p₀)/n。
derivation.en: Under H₀ each variance is p₀(1−p₀); independence and scaling give Var₀(p̂)=p₀(1−p₀)/n.

derivation.zh: 取正平方根为SE₀=√[p₀(1−p₀)/n]。减去H₀均值再除SE₀，得到z=(p̂−p₀)/SE₀。
derivation.en: Take SE₀=√[p₀(1−p₀)/n], then center and scale to get z=(p̂−p₀)/SE₀.

derivation.zh: 固定0<p₀<1且样本足够适合时，由伯努利中心极限定理，z在H₀下近似N(0,1)。检查np₀与n(1−p₀)计数，例如均至少10；稀疏情形考虑精确二项法。
derivation.en: For fixed 0<p₀<1, a suitable large sample gives approximate standard normality by the Bernoulli CLT. Check both null expected counts, using 10 each as a basic screen; sparse cases may require an exact binomial test.

derivation.zh: 此处是检验H₀，所以分母用p₀；比例Wald区间是在估计未知p，才常用p̂代入。p₀=0或1会让分母为0，不能使用这条z公式。
derivation.en: The test denominator uses p₀ because the reference world is H₀. A Wald interval estimates unknown p and uses p̂. At p₀=0 or 1 the z denominator vanishes, so this formula cannot be used.

scenario.zh: 随机独立调查100人，60人赞成。双侧检验p₀=0.5，α=0.05。计算z与近似p值。
scenario.en: Survey 100 random independent people with 60 approvals. Test p₀=0.5 two-sided at 0.05; calculate z and its approximate p-value.

steps.zh: p̂=60/100=0.6；H₀下期望成功和失败都为50。
steps.en: p̂=60/100=0.6; null expected counts are 100×0.5=50 each.

steps.zh: 近似双尾p=2[1−Φ(2)]≈0.045500264<0.05，按本近似规则拒绝；若改用精确二项检验，p值和临界结论可能不同。
steps.en: The approximate two-sided p≈0.045500264<0.05 rejects under this approximation. An exact binomial test may give a different p-value and decision.
